P!NK - Acoustic Performance [NMPA Annual Meeting 2026] (1080p HD)​


​
Three days after she hosts the 2026 Tony Awards, P!nk is set to receive the NMPA Songwriter Icon Award at the National Music Publishers’ Association annual meeting, which will take place at Lincoln Center’s Alice Tully Hall in New York on June 10. The event will include industry analysis, announcements and performances. P!nk has landed four No. 1 singles on the Billboard Hot 100 and three No. 1 albums on the all-genre Billboard 200. She has won three Grammys, two BRIT Awards, a Daytime Emmy and seven MTV Video Music Awards.
​


More information: https://www.nmpa.org/pnk-to-receive-nmpa-songwriter-icon-award-at-annual-meeting/
